Blunder Bob, disguised as a Tipplesome Patron, is a Redcap Mystic Cannoneer in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
I'm cock-eyed... ANOTHER!
„
— Blunder Bob

Involvement

Act Three

Blunder Bob is on the second floor of The Blushing Mermaid having a jolly good time. He remains disguised as long as combat does not start.
